notes.title: Bosses update !
notes.content:
[b]Now update is now live![/b]

This update add boss levels to the game.
Those levels are longer and harder than the classic mini-games, between 30-60 secondes, and are used as transitions before leveling up.

For now we have 6 uniques bosses: 3 medium and 3 hard.
More will be added with future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43310062/3425613b59c79dc405d68c881b064c994029340f.png[/img]

notes.title: First update!
notes.content:
Update 0.2 is now live :)

[h1]-- CHANGELOG --[/h1]

[h2]New[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new minigame in Run and Gun style
[*] Another new minigame, inspired by those old FPS on NES
[*] Full gamepad support. Every menu is now navigable with gamepad
[*] Joystick support
[*] Changed buttons labels in keybinding to avoid confusions
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Keybinding not saving
[*] Audio and SFX volume not saving
[*] Enemy and player bullets going through levels in library mode
[*] Red borders around bats
[*] Library mode bugging when losing/winning right before timer end
[*] Some SFX playing on the audio soundtrack
[*] Inconsistent blocks speed between library and arena mode
[/list]

notes.title: Sneak peek and Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]First of all, happy new year 2023![/h1]

I think it’s a good time to share with you how the game will be updated during the early access and what to expect for the next few months.
I want the game to be finished by mid-2023 and one major update should be available at the end of each month.

Every update should contains:
[list]
[*] 2 new mini-games
[*] One new major feature
[*] And of course some bug fixes/various improvements
[/list]
For January, I want to focus on making the game fully compatible with gamepads. 
It should make the game more enjoyable on steam-deck, and switching back to the mouse between each play, not necessary anymore.

February should see the arrival of “bosses”: new special levels, much longer than the normal ones. They will be used as transitions before leveling up.

[b]And to finish, a small sneak peek to the next mini-game ;)[/b]
